title: TeamFlowRL: Online Policy Optimization of Decentralized Flow Policies for Multi-Agent Coordination
summary: TeamFlowRL replaces Gaussian-policy online fine-tuning of offline-pretrained generative (flow) policies with team-level policy optimization over complete denoising trajectories, sidestepping intractable action likelihoods by weighting per-agent trajectory ratios with a shared team advantage. It costs a two-stage pipeline: offline multi-agent flow pretraining on demonstration trajectories followed by online RL with environment access, plus simulation infrastructure and per-agent ratio clipping machinery. It can fail where no simulator or reward signal exists, where offline datasets are unavailable, and its gains are demonstrated only in simulation benchmarks, so transfer to real systems is unvalidated.
rationale: The method targets multi-agent coordination in simulated robotics and requires offline trajectory datasets plus online environment interaction for RL fine-tuning, which does not match a production LLM engineering workload on a single GPU or API budget.
technique: Online RL fine-tuning of decentralized flow policies
